{{for|the item purchasable from [[The Bog Witch]]|Powdered dragon eggshells}} {{infobox item | title = Dragon egg | image = Dragon egg.png | description = | id = DragonEgg | type = Misc | source = [[Drake Nest]] | usage = Summon [[Moder]] | buy = | sell = | weight = 200.0 | stack = 1 | teleport = No | materials = }} '''Dragon eggs''' are items found in [[Drake Nest]]s in the [[Mountains]]. They are far heavier than they look, with a faint humming sound. == Usage ==
''Main article: [[Forsaken Altars]]''
A total of three Dragon eggs are required in order to summon the fourth boss [[Moder]]. ==Gallery== Dragon egg.jpg Dragon nest night.jpg 20210326202825_1.jpg ==Notes== * Dragon eggs cannot be teleported without a [[Portal stone]], and are one of the heaviest items overall at 200.0 units. * Up to 3 [[Drake]]s protect each egg. They do not respawn. * Dragon eggs will respawn after {{Duration|28800}}. ==Tips== * It is not needed to haul the eggs long distances or via ship, they can simply be collected in the same Mountain biome as the Moder altar. ** The only exception is if there are fewer than 3, although that is rather uncommon. {{MaterialsNav}} [[Category:Forsaken_offerings]] [[zh-tw:龍蛋]] [[ru:Яйцо дракона]]
